column3: “In faithfulness” is rendered “had the responsibility,” and “flat cakes” as “things which were baked in pans.”
“The bread of the row” is rendered “the showbread.”
“Set free” is rendered “free from other service,” and NASB supplies “of the temple.”
“Before their relatives” is rendered “opposite their other relatives.”
NASB includes “and Ahaz,” which is not in the Hebrew here but appears in 8:35.
